profile.text: Her real given name is Lisa, her surname hidden at the request of her guardian. Miss Suzuran may be young, but she has inherited a profound talent for Originium Arts from her lineage. She is also under the guidance of Dr. Kal'tsit while receiving treatment at Rhodes Island. After Miss Suzuran decided to apply to Rhodes Island, she was approved to participate in some low-difficulty tasks under the supervision of other operators.
